build_vit_base_model: build a VisionTransformer base model with 768 embed dim and 12 layers using vit_base factory
build_vit_large_model: build a VisionTransformer large model with 1024 embed dim and 24 layers using vit_large factory
update_dropout_rate: update the dropout rate on all Dropout modules in a VisionTransformer model at runtime
update_drop_path_rate: update the drop path stochastic depth rate across all blocks in a VisionTransformer model
reset_classifier_head: reset the classifier head of a VisionTransformer to a new number of output classes
